newsitem.title: USA: NASD seeking comment on bond fund "risk ratings".
newsitem.headline: NASD seeking comment on bond fund "risk ratings".

text.p: NASD Regulation Inc next week will request public comment on whether to propose a rule that would permit "risk ratings" in sales literature for bond funds, a top NASD official said Friday.

R. Clark Hooper, senior vice president of National Association of Securities Dealers Regulation (NASDR), discussed the highly controversial issue during a press briefing after NASDR's board meeting here.
NASDR's board in September already voted to issue some kind of "concept notice" on the idea, which is opposed by a number of mutual funds, Hooper said.
At this week's meeting, the board reviewed some specific ideas put forward by NASDR staff and voted to distribute them next week to the public and firms for comment, Hooper said.
Risk ratings are being pushed by Standard & Poor's Rating Group, a major municipal bond rating agency.
